title: Need help i’m new
author: vickyisaG
selftext:
Hey, so I have been working towards automating ny strategy which revolves mainly around liquidity sweeps paired up with one other confluence, pretty basic. It trades SPY and uses QQQ for SMT confluence alone.

It’s completely based on python which I built with the help of claude. I am using 5 year alpaca data (free limit).

I wanna know if these results are decent? What else should I test it with? How do i move forward with a python bot?

My main concern is that I want to use it with prop firm accounts, so what’s the best way to use a python strategy with prop firms as in my knowledge none of the prop firms supports a broker/software that has python algo, most of them operate with metatrader, and i feel translating it to mql5 will cause variance in logic and might fail completely.

What should be my next steps to confirm this strategy is good or needs improvement? Is there a free software to test on historical and live data for python algos? 

What might be the best ways for me to improve this bot? Can I introduce machine learning into this or what might be other ways to improve on this? I feel like i’ve hit the wall now. 

Any suggestions are welcome, help a brother out cos i’m new to all this.

comments.author: Due_Communication849
comments.body:
Consider adding brokerage logics as well ( just an estimate should be fine)
Most strategies feel good on paper because they dont account for brokerage and slippage(difference between entry price and execution price)
A lot of this profit would bleed because of these two things
If you add these and even then the startegy seems profitable then you can go live

replies.author: vickyisaG
replies.body: With prop firms there’s no brokerage or commissions, however spreads might cause an issue, thanks for the insight though!

comments.author: Due_Communication849
comments.body: Btw did you use free claude model or the paid version ?

replies.author: vickyisaG
replies.body: The free version, I use multiple accounts while maintaining a strategy document that gets updated every prompt to tackle the rate limit issue

comments.author: Due_Communication849
comments.body: One last thing that i would suggest you is ask claude to add a detailed info for each trade in a lot of my setups that i tested when i see the individual trade entry time and manually check that day on the chart there is no clear setup at all beacuse code doesnt think or see like a human you might find many wrong trade which passed the code check but are actually bad and non sense and then you can add filters to remove those trades

comments.author: funeralbot
comments.body: You might have better results running a local model and having it do all this for you. Alpha vantage api is free. So is duck duck go mcp search which can scrape yahoo finance.

comments.author: Ai_copywriting_agent
comments.body: If you do a path dependent Monte Carlo it can tell you the probility of passing with its stability score , if its stability score is higher the logic is sound and cannot be distorted too much swapping somewhere else but if you are still worried you can use a webhook that send alert to mtr5 so it still uses that python script
